sources.title: OpenStreetMap: standing hospital footprint
sources.note: ODbL. Complete mapped grounds, standing roofs and neighboring road geometry are retained.

sources.title: Source-relative hospital landscaping estimate
sources.note: No hospital image was supplied. The small front and east-side visual envelope, lawns, planting and connecting walks are schematic estimates derived from open space around the complete saved OSM hospital roof and neighboring footprints. It is not a surveyed hospital parcel, tree inventory or verified entrance layout. Adjacent buildings and the full Panganiban Drive carriageway remain clear and retain geometry.

sources.title: Draft layout limits
sources.note: Added positions, crown sizes, height estimates, path widths and low planting are undated drafts. No surveyed boundary, species, construction history, vehicle inventory or verified accessibility claim is inferred.
